_about:
TANGLISH FOR THE BLUEPRINT STEPS - a sidecar, and it has to be one.

src/data/steps.feature.json and steps.short.json are REGENERATED by
`npm run extract`, which reads legacy/ and lifts Tanglish out of the
.tn spans it finds there. The extractor already supports deckTanglish;
it emits none because the 2023 pages never had a Tanglish deck. So
anything written by hand into those files is destroyed on the next
extraction, and legacy/ must never be edited to prevent that.

This file is therefore the only safe home for hand-written Tanglish on
the steps. src/ui/steps.js merges it at render time. The merge FILLS
GAPS ONLY: where the extractor produced Tanglish from legacy/, that
wins, so there is still one source per string.

Keyed `<namespace>:<step id>` because step ids repeat across
blueprints - there is a step-01 in both the feature and the short.

why[] is indexed by the order of `why` blocks within that step.
npm run verify fails on a key that matches no step, so this cannot
quietly rot out of step with the data it decorates.

decks.feature:step-01: Ovvoru padamum, unna vitte pogaadha oru kelvila thaan aarambikkudhu. Adha inga pidichu vachukkonga - pachchaiyaa, thiruththaama, entha vadivathulayum.
decks.feature:step-02: Padam muzhusaiyum oru vaakkiyathukkulla adakkunga. Mudiyala-nna, neenga enna ezhudhareenga-nu ungalukke innum theriyala.
decks.feature:step-03: Theme-nu solradhu unga padam enna vaadhaadudhu-nu. Stakes-nu solradhu, andha vaadhathukkaaga adhu edha pandhayam vekkudhu-nu.
decks.feature:step-04: Hero-va ullerundhu veliya kattunga. Mudhal page-la avan nambura poi thaan avanoda muzhu arc.
decks.feature:step-05: Nalla villain kettavan illa. Edhiraana oru aasai, unmaiyaana oru kolgai, appuram thaan thaan hero-nu nenaikkuradhukku oru kaaranam - indha moonum irukkura oru manushan.
decks.feature:step-06: Ovvoru thunai kadhaapaathiramum hero-va pirathibalikkanum, sodhikkanum, illa maathhanum. Illaatti avanga set property thaan.
decks.feature:step-07: Unga kalam thaan moonaavadhu kadhaapaathiram. Adhukku vidhigal, thanmai, oru paarvai - moonum kudunga.
decks.feature:step-08: Amaippoda mudhugelumbu. Innum katchi ezhudhaadheenga - ovvoru kattamum enna saadhikkanum-nu mattum ezhudhunga.
decks.feature:step-09: Unga kadhai kaalathoda vilaiyaadudhu-nna - flashback, reveal, inaiyaana kadhaigal - edha eppo veliya kondu varradhu-nu andha varisaiya ippove design pannunga.
decks.feature:step-10: Act 3-la unga romba periya anju payoff-a list pannunga. Ovvondrukkum, adha munnaadi edhu vidhaikkudhu, enga vidhaikkudhu-nu peru solunga.
decks.feature:step-11: Ovvoru kattathaiyum unmaiyaana katchigalaa pirichunga. Outline-ukkum draft-ukkum edaila irukkura paalam idhu thaan.
decks.feature:step-12: FADE IN-nu ezhudhuradhukku munnaadi indha list-a oru thadava paarunga. Ellaa box-um tick aayiruchu-nna, ungakitta oru padam irukku.
decks.feature:step-13: Asainjukitte irukkura target mela pre-production aarambikka mudiyaadhu. Script-a lock pannunga. Appuram adha breakdown pannunga.
decks.feature:step-14: Ellaa department-aiyum nilaiyaa pidichu vekkura oru page. DOP-um costume designer-um rendu vera vision-a padichukittu irundhaa, ungakitta padam illa - sandai thaan.
decks.feature:step-15: Paragraph-a vida padangal nallaa vaadhaadum. Unga vision-a ovvoru department-um copy pannakoodiya thelivaana vivarangalaa maathhura visual library-a kattunga.
decks.feature:step-16: Camera ungala plan pannuradhukku munnaadi neenga camera-va plan pannunga. Katchigal shot-aa maarum; shot-gal set-la neramaa maarum.
decks.feature:step-17: Camera, lens, lighting, color. Shooting aarambichadhukku appuram, inga eduththa mudivugala kittathatta maathhave mudiyaadhu.
decks.feature:step-18: Set, props, board, ovvoru mesaila irukkura ovvoru tumbler. Sariyaa irundhaa production design-a audience kavanikka maattaanga - thappaa irundhaa nichchayam kavanippaanga.
decks.feature:step-19: Udai-nu solradhe character thaan. Ovvoru nadigarukkum ovvoru katchikkum, script-a anijikkakoodiya oru adayaalamaa costume designer maathhuraaru.
decks.feature:step-20: Role idam kudukkum podhu, edhirpaarkkura type-ukku edhiraa cast pannunga. Action sollaradhukku munnaadi ellaarum serndhu rehearse pannunga.
decks.feature:step-21: Rendu thadava paarunga, oru thadava shoot pannunga. Oru location lens, lighting, sound, blocking ellaathaiyum mudivu pannudhu. Thappaana location = thappaana padam.
decks.feature:step-22: Sound-nu solradhu padathula paadhi. Composer brief-um sound design plan-um shoot-ukku MUNNAADI nadakkanum, appuram illa.
decks.feature:step-23: Producer-oda moonu thoongal. Oru padam naatkalla eduththu, laksham-la kaasu kuduththu, sariyaana HOD-gala vachu odudhu.
decks.feature:step-24: Pre-production-oda kadaisi vaaram. Ellaa department-um serndhu ellaa mukkiya location-aiyum nadandhu paakkudhu. Inga kandupidikkura ovvoru pirachanaiyum set-la oru naala kaappaathhum.
decks.short:step-01: Ovvoru short-um pirikka mudiyaadha oru vishayathula aarambikkudhu. Oru image. Oru kanam. Oru kelvi. Neenga edho oru edathula kettu vachcha oru vaakkiyam. Oru frame ezhudhuradhukku munnaadi adha kandupidinga.
decks.short:step-02: Short film logline feature-a vida innum irukkamaa irukkanum. Irupathanju vaarthaikkulla. Festival selector-gal nooru kanakkula padikraanga. Ungadhu ettu vinaadila iranganum.
decks.short:step-03: Oru hero. Oru aasai. Oru thadai. Runtime adhukku mela idam kudukkaadhu. Adhukku mela vechaa audience adha thaanga mudiyaadhu.
decks.short:step-04: Feature-oda pathinanju kattathai marandhudunga. Short-ukku anju thaan: Setup, Disturbance, Escalation, Turn, Image. Ovvoru kattamum than edathai sambaadhikkanum, illaatti cut.
decks.short:step-05: Short-ukku ulagam-nu solradhu podhuvaa oru location, oru neram, oru vaanilai. Indha kattupaadugal compromise illa - indha vadivathoda balam adhu thaan.
decks.short:step-06: Nerayya short-gal anju thoda pannirandu katchila velai seiyum. Oru vasanam ezhudhuradhukku munnaadi avatra list pannunga. Ovvoru katchiyum moonula kammiyanadhu onnaavadhu seiyanum: character-a velippaduththanum, aasaiya munnokki nagarthhanum, illa turn-ukku kalam amaikkanum.
decks.short:step-07: Ippo unmaiyaana screenplay-a ezhudhunga. Keela irukkura editor unga slug, action, vasanam ellaathaiyum thaanaave format pannum. Oru samayathula oru katchi. Munnaadi thaandi ponga vendaam.
decks.short:step-08: Unga script-a sariyaana screenplay format-la nerala paarunga; koodave Fountain-aa export pannunga - entha professional app-um thirakkakoodiya podhuvaana screenplay markdown adhu.
decks.short:step-09: Nerayya short-gal onnu thoda naalu naatkalla, moonu thoda aaru per crew-vodu, onnu thoda moonu location-la shoot aagum. Script-a final pannuradhukku munnaadi unga nijathai theriyum-naa, unmaiyila shoot panna mudiyaadhadha cut panna mudiyum.
decks.short:step-10: Short film oru visiting card. Adha makkal paakkura vazhi festival thaan. Vyuham: moonu nilaila pannirandu thoda irupadhu festival thernthedunga, seekiram submit pannunga, top-tier reject aaguradhukku munnaadi ondrum online-la release panna vendaam.
decks.short:step-11: Vaay vittu padinga, rendu thadava sari paarunga, appuram lock pannunga. Idhukku appuram, set-la edhavadhu pudhusaa kandupidichaa thavira script maaraadhu.
decks.production:step-25: Pre-production-nu solradhu mudivu edukkuradhu. Production-nu solradhu andha mudivugala vaanilai kitta irundhum, kadigaaram kitta irundhum, maalai naalu manikku ellaarukkum thonra nalla ideas kitta irundhum kaappaathhuradhu.
decks.production:step-26: Kaasu selavu panname post-la thappa sari panna mudiyaadha ore department idhu thaan. Kannaala paakkura varaikkum adha ezhudhi vachudunga.
decks.production:step-27: Enna shoot panna ninaicheengalo adha illa, unmaiyila enna shoot pannuneengalo adha paarunga. Andha rendukkum edaila irukkura idaiveli thaan neenga unmaiyila eduththukittu irukkura padam.
decks.production:step-28: Shoot mudiyudhu. Kadamaigal mudiyala. Makkal innum unga phone-a eduththu pesura varaikkum avatra mudichudunga.
decks.production:step-29: Ellaame, varisaiyaa, romba neelamaa. Adha muzhusaakkuradhukku munnaadiye nallaa aakkanum-nu thonradha kattupaduththunga.
decks.production:step-30: Sound, music, colour aarambikkuradhukkaaga cut asaiyuradha nirutthudhu. Nazhuvikitte irukkura oru lock, andha moonu department-ukkum rendu thadava selavu vekkudhu.
decks.production:step-31: Padathula paadhi; kadaisila panradhu, budget vetta vandhaa mudhalla vettapaduradhu. Adha kaappaathhunga: konjam mosamaana image-a audience mannichuduvaanga, therilaadha vasanatha oru naalum mannikka maattaanga.
decks.production:step-32: Colour, titles, captions, masters. Yaaravadhu unga padatha unmaiyila potu paakka mudiyuma-nu mudivu panra, ganam illaadha andha rendu vaaram.

short:step-01: Thole poara nerayya short-gal chinna feature-aa irukka paakkudhu - romba character, romba subplot, romba idea. Jeyikkura short-gal oru vishayatha patthi mattum irukkura dhairiyam ullavai. Andha vishayam illaadha ellaathaiyum vetta ungalukku anumadhi kudukkuradhu andha seed thaan.
short:step-02: Festival programmer-galukku varushathukku anjaayiram-ukku mela short film submission varum. Andha file-a paakkalaamaa-nu mudivu panra mudhal irupathanju vaarthai unga logline thaan. Adhe vaakkiyathai thaan adutha varusham irunooru thadava solla porenga - nadigar kitta, crew kitta, festival kitta, pathirikaiyaalar kitta. Adha kooraa vachukkonga.
short:step-03: Feature-la pathu irupadhu katchi vachu character-a valarthhalaam. Short-ukku anju thoda pathinanju nimisham thaan. Unga character mudhal muppadhu vinaadila puriyanum - vasanam mulamaa illa, avanga edukkura mudivugal mulamaa. Oru-aasai / oru-thadai amaippu thaan, feature-ukku thevaipadura andha setup-a thavirkka vidudhu.
short:step-04: Oru short, sketch maadhiri illaama kadhai maadhiri thonanum-naa thevaipadura kuraindhapatcha amaippu indha anju kattam thaan. Anjum illaatti, edho onnu kuraiyudhu-nu audience unarvaanga - adhu enna-nu solla mudiyaattiyum. Romba sagajamaa nadakkura thavaru: anjaavadhu kattam illaama poradhu. Oru turn nadakkudhu, aana artham adanga oru irudhi katchila padam vandhu nikkala.
short:step-06: Unga runtime-la perumpaalaanadha escalation kattathula (Beat 3) thaan selavu panna porenga. Anga thaan scene map romba mukkiyam. Valuvatra escalation = nagaraama nikkura katchigal. Valuvaana escalation = ovvoru katchiyum mundhaiyadha vida irukkam, ovvondrum turn-ukku innum pakkam.
short:step-09: Mudhal muraiyaa panra nerayya short-gal pre-production-laye thole poradhukku kaaranam: budget kudukka mudiyaadha vishayangala script kekkudhu - drone shot, kuzhandhai nadigar, period costume, iravu veli katchi. Script lock-ukku munnaadi avatra vettunga. Nalla milivaana short, compromise pannina vilai adhigamaana short-a eppovume jeyikkum.
short:step-10: Mudhal murai padam panravanga panra romba periya thavaru: short mudinja anniye adha YouTube-la potuduradhu. Premiere kattupaadu ulla ovvoru festival-lum unga vaaippa adhu kondudum - top festival-la perumpaalaanavai apdi thaan. Online release-nu solradhu KADAISI padi, festival run mudinja appuram; mudhal padi illa.
